source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION for one approved complete SDR, but incorrectly prefixes 24h with a reservation ID; requests returned-ID readback and targeted rollback.

old_problem: The historical review correctly refused to invent persistent SDR content but treated the standard operation as wholly undefined and repeated an unsupported generic checksum expectation. The GPT V2 proposal also places a reservation ID before the 24h Add payload, contrary to the IPMI 2.0 request layout. Sections 33 and 43 define complete-record Add, returned Record ID, repository modes, header/key/body length, Get SDR readback and targeted Delete recovery. The exact inert disposable record and monitoring oracle remain Project artifacts that can be parameterized without leaving the protocol decision Pending.
disposition_reason: On a verified writable repository with authoritative Add 24h and Delete 26h support, add exactly one absent owner-approved inert SDR whose complete 5+Record-Length bytes fit one secret-safe OOB request. Respect the advertised modal/non-modal update mode; send 24h followed directly by the complete SDR and no reservation prefix. Require completion 00h plus a valid assigned Record ID, then obtain fresh reservations because Add may cancel them, reconstruct the stored record with bounded 23h reads, verify assigned-ID header and every remaining byte, and prove only the approved monitoring effect. Re-identify the unique key, delete that one RID with 26h, and reconcile canonical record-key/body content because volatile IDs/timestamps may change. Never guess standard/OEM fields, clear the repository, use Partial Add, retry an ambiguous Add or expose OOB credentials.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1207-1212, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The related IB Add row 1084/new review event 225 was read and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 85 was read from the locked queue and verified against XLSX/manifest as row 1212 / variant e26a80a8e8844739.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Add SDR to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 24h. Section 33.13 requires the complete SDR data in one request and returns completion plus a two-byte Record ID least-significant byte first. The request has no reservation-ID prefix; the V2 instruction to include one is corrected.

Section 43 defines a five-byte SDR header followed by contiguous record-key fields and a type-specific body. Header bytes are Record ID (two), SDR Version, Record Type and Record Length; the complete vector must contain exactly 5+Record-Length bytes.

The standard SDR record model has no universal record checksum field. IPMI transport checksums are handled by the interface, while an OEM payload can contain owner-defined integrity fields only when its schema says so. A blanket checksum requirement is therefore invalid.

Record IDs are repository access handles and can be reassigned or recycled after mutations. The RID returned by 24h is authoritative for the transaction, but stable record key fields and the body must also match before readback credit or deletion.

Sections 33.1-33.2 distinguish non-modal repositories from modal repositories requiring Enter/Exit SDR Repository Update Mode. The Project must choose the authoritative advertised mode; the test must not probe both or strand the BMC in update mode.

Repository Info/Allocation establish update capability, overflow and capacity before mutation. When the complete record exceeds the remote channel request limit, this full Add identity is NOT READY or not applicable as documented; the distinct Partial Add row 1212 cannot be used to claim 24h coverage.

Add may cancel an existing reservation. Reservation 22h is therefore acquired after Add for offset/chunk 23h reconstruction and again before 26h deletion; an invalidated reservation stops the transaction instead of triggering automatic retry.

SDRs control sensor discovery, units, thresholds and initialization. Syntax-only success is unsafe: the fixture must be owner-approved, unique and inert or have an exact contained effect oracle, and monitoring/alert/control behavior must be checked.

Targeted Delete 26h is the bounded recovery. If it is unavailable and the record is not an intentional approved permanent configuration with an independently reviewed recovery path, execution is NOT READY. Full Clear 27h is prohibited.
OOB additionally requires endpoint-to-asset binding, protected credential handling and transport/session evidence. IB row 1084 cannot satisfy this Source Key even when the record bytes are identical.

ED-02 preserves identity; ED-03 separates standard framing from OEM payload authority; ED-13/ED-15 govern N/A and exact acceptance; ED-17 preserves evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery/approval; ED-34 permits the record fixture as Project configuration; ED-38 prohibits retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Add SDR (OOB Storage 0Ah/24h) complete approved record, assigned-ID readback and targeted removal
test_case.purpose: Exercise complete-record Add SDR once through the authenticated OOB path with an absent owner-approved disposable record, verify repository-assigned identity, exact stored bytes and bounded monitoring behavior, then remove only that record and reconcile the original logical repository without clear, Partial Add or IB substitution.
required_package: Approved BMC/SUT/firmware and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus endpoint bound to FRU/serial, with a writable SDR repository and authoritative Add 24h/Delete 26h support

Version-controlled APPROVED_SDR_BYTES and decoded schema: approved Record-ID placeholder, authoritative SDR version/type, Record-Length with total=5+length, unique key fields, complete body, and for OEM data a registered IANA plus exact owner schema

Proof the fixture is inert/disposable or an exact contained effect oracle; duplicate/key-collision scan; immutable raw baseline export; canonical baseline multiset keyed by stable type/key/body; monitoring/alert/control inventory
Repository Info/Allocation evidence proving update mode, no overflow and adequate space; verified OOB request-size limit proving the complete 24h payload fits one request

Pinned OOB raw runner without command-line secrets or hidden retries; fresh-reservation chunked 23h reader, RID parser, exact-key 26h recovery, modal Exit path if applicable, maintenance window, immediate confirmation and independent BMC/monitoring owner
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED OOB SDR MUTATION; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind BMC DNS/IP, FRU/serial and firmware to the intended SUT; preserve every SDR raw/decoded plus SEL/BMC/OS evidence. Capture 0Ah/20h repository info, 21h allocation when supported, authoritative mode and a canonical multiset excluding volatile RIDs; prove the fixture key absent. Validate every fixture byte against its standard or owner OEM schema, exact total=5+Record-Length, approved RID placeholder, uniqueness, effect oracle, capacity and one-request OOB fit; do not invent a checksum. Require 26h recovery and no incident/retention hold. For modal mode, enter 2Ah once with a preauthorized 2Bh exit; for non-modal do not enter. Display endpoint, full redacted/hashed fixture and recovery, obtain immediate approval, then send exactly once over host-verified secret-safe LANPlus: Storage 0Ah/24h followed directly by all APPROVED_SDR_BYTES, with no reservation prefix. Require completion 00h and exactly one assigned RID neither 0000h nor FFFFh. On ambiguous completion, do not resend; enumerate once by stable key. Acquire a fresh 22h reservation, reconstruct RID with bounded 23h chunks from offset zero and compare header RID plus every byte 3..N to the fixture. Exit modal mode if entered; verify the approved sensor/inventory/threshold/alert/control effect and no unrelated impact. Acquire another fresh reservation, re-read stable key/body and issue 26h only for that exact RID. Require returned RID, key absence and canonical count/capacity/overflow/content reconciliation while documenting legitimate ID/timestamp changes. Never use 25h, 27h clear, initialization agent, reset or IB Add as a substitute.
test_case.expected_result: One complete OOB 24h request without reservation prefix returns completion 00h and a valid assigned RID. Fresh-reservation 23h reads reconstruct exactly one stored record whose RID header and remaining version/type/length/key/body bytes match the approved fixture; repository metadata changes coherently and only the approved contained monitoring footprint appears. Targeted 26h deletion identifies and removes that RID, the unique key disappears, overflow stays clear, count returns to baseline and the canonical stable-key/body multiset plus monitoring state match baseline even if RIDs or update timestamps changed. Unsupported/read-only Add is N/A only with authoritative target evidence. Ambiguity, mismatch, duplicate, unintended effect or incomplete recovery is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact OOB identity and endpoint binding, writable/Add/Delete capability, complete one-request approved fixture with valid header/length and unique key, capacity/mode/transport proof, immediate approval, one 24h completion plus valid RID, complete fresh-reservation 23h byte equality, expected monitoring behavior, exact-key 26h removal and canonical recovery. FAIL covers a reservation prefixed to 24h, guessed standard/OEM bytes, invented checksum, length mismatch, invalid/ambiguous RID, duplicate key, normalized/body mismatch, unintended sensor/threshold/control/alert impact, credential exposure, Partial Add or IB substitution, clear/reset/retry or failed deletion. NOT READY covers missing fixture/schema/capacity/mode/request fit/Delete/containment/approval. N/A needs authoritative read-only or Add-unsupported evidence; OOB transport/session error alone is insufficient.
safety_gate: Use one owner-approved disposable record whose stable key is absent and whose monitoring/control effect is bounded. Never create a plausible generic sensor, duplicate an existing key or guess OEM IANA/data.
Bind endpoint to FRU/serial/firmware and supply secrets outside command arguments/logs. Stop on any target/session ambiguity before mutation.
Preserve the repository and downstream state. Clear SDR 27h, SEL/log clearing, record batching and evidence suppression are forbidden recovery methods.

The complete record must fit one 24h request and 24h must not receive a reservation prefix. If it cannot fit, keep this identity NOT READY/N/A as supported by authority and review Partial Add separately.
Honor one authoritative modal/non-modal path. Modal execution must retain independent access and preapproved Exit 2Bh; uncertainty about exit or controller availability stops execution.
Treat RID as a volatile handle and revalidate stable key/body before delete. Reconcile canonical content, not a misleading raw repository hash that would fail solely due to legitimate RID changes.

No automatic retry. After ambiguous 24h, enumerate once by the unique key rather than re-adding. Delete only one positively matched RID with a fresh reservation; on mismatch/failure preserve evidence and escalate without clear/reset.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/SUT/firmware/FRU and OOB endpoint/channel binding; official sections 33/43 and Appendix G authority; distinct row-1084 IB identity
Immutable raw/decoded repository export, canonical stable-key/body baseline, repository info/allocation/mode, remote request-size limit, duplicate scan and monitoring baseline
Fixture source/revision/hash and complete decoded header/key/body, placeholder authority, exact length calculation, standard or IANA/OEM ownership, effect oracle and immediate confirmation
Exact redacted no-reservation-prefix 24h request/completion, returned RID, post-add metadata, fresh reservations and complete ordered 23h reconstruction comparison
Expected-versus-actual sensor/inventory/threshold/alert/control footprint, credential-safe session audit and modal enter/exit evidence when applicable

Fresh-reservation identity check, exact 26h delete/returned RID, key absence, canonical repository/count/capacity/overflow recovery and PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A; explicit statement that the review agent ran no DUT action
test_case.recovery: Precondition execution on authoritative targeted Delete 26h and, for modal repositories, Exit 2Bh. If 24h completion is ambiguous, never resend: leave modal mode if required, enumerate once by unique stable key and classify zero/one/multiple matches. Delete only one positively matched record after a fresh reservation and immediate key/body check, then reconcile canonical baseline and monitoring. If no unique match, modal exit fails, deletion fails or canonical content diverges, stop all writes, preserve raw exports and alerts, and hand recovery to the BMC/SDR owner. Never clear/repopulate, reset BMC, switch to IB or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves 24h request/response, absence of reservation prefix, record structure/mode, readback and targeted recovery. The Review layer replaces TBD/log clearing and corrects V2's malformed request; OEM body meaning remains explicitly Project-owned.

blocked.reason: Core Add behavior and bounded Delete recovery are defined. Exact fixture, target capability, capacity, mode, OOB request fit and monitoring oracle are enforceable Project prerequisites rather than unresolved protocol semantics.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 33.1-33.16 and 43 plus Appendix G define writable/modal repositories, Storage 0Ah/Cmd24h complete-record Add without reservation prefix and returned RID, five-byte header/key/body length rule, reservation cancellation, bounded 23h readback, volatile RIDs and targeted 26h deletion.

project_authority: The SDR/BMC owner supplies the exact compatible disposable record and placeholder convention, standard/OEM body authority, capability/mode/capacity/OOB-size proof, effect oracle, consumer window, confirmation and delete/exit recovery. It cannot prefix 24h with a reservation, invent a checksum, guess OEM bytes, accept completion without full readback, cross-credit Partial Add/IB, demand raw-hash equality after RID reassignment, expose credentials or use clear/reset/retry.
